# Vetta 0.6.17
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-23 -->

## English

### Improvements

- Settings → Usage now opens on today's numbers, so you no longer have to switch away from the last 7 days first. Other ranges are still one click away.
- Shortcut hints in the ⌘T panel (↵, Esc and the panel shortcut) are now thin rounded outlines with larger, crisp key labels, so they stay readable on the glass panel.

### Fixes

- In the UI Design canvas, frames other than the first no longer briefly show the first frame's image after opening a design.

## 中文

### 改进

- 设置「用量」页打开时直接显示今天的数据，不用再从近 7 天切过去；其他时间范围仍可一键切换。
- ⌘T 面板里的快捷键提示（↵、Esc 和面板快捷键）改为大圆角细线框，键位符号更大更清楚，在玻璃面板上不再发虚。

### 修复

- 界面设计画布里，打开设计稿后第一帧以外的画板不会再短暂显示成第一帧的画面。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.16...v0.6.17
